svg.title: RaizHost CI checks and release selection
svg.desc: The embedding guide provides a complete text walkthrough of this flow.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CI: types, lint, read/UI tests
Build, prerender guard, poller bundle

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Select deployment revision
CI head SHA or dispatch SHA

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Manual Deploy dispatch
No CI-success prerequisite

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
OIDC role → web image
Static assets + three poller ZIPs

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Same-repository PR
or push to main

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CI: build + e2e
Types, lint, tests, browser journey

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Publish ARM64 image to ECR
Tag = CI commit SHA

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Deploy requires successful CI
push + main + same repository

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Deploy exact CI head SHA
OIDC role → SSM on anchor

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CI quality suite
Build, contracts, browser checks

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Push to live
Code or owner content commit

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Manual Deploy dispatch on live
Full SHA + approve_production

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Checkout equals selected SHA
SHA is ancestor of live
Run deployment checks

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
OIDC role → S3 upload
Request CDN invalidation
